primaryGuidance.summary: Retained off-device data counts even for functionality. Optional features are not automatically exempt. Linked identity includes account/device associations. Tracking requires the specified cross-company advertising or broker use, not simply ads. Local processing and Apple’s own framework collection are distinct. Generic free text does not require every conceivable sensitive-data category.

SDK may collect IP/general location, device identifiers, ad interactions and diagnostics. Exact installed SDK/manifests, optional features and mediation must be reviewed; this is not an app-specific traffic capture.

matrix.tracking: No tracking use found in inspected own-service path.

matrix.proposalStatus: Include for active invitation email flow

matrix.tracking: No advertising use established for transactional invitations.
matrix.remainingFact: Confirm production mail feature and handling; no actual messages/logs queried.

matrix.observedDataAndFlow: Installation identifier/APNs token registered with principal and timestamps in server storage.
matrix.linkedToUser: Yes when registration tied to principal/device.
matrix.tracking: No tracking use established for push-delivery identifier.

matrix.dataType: Usage Data / Product Interaction or Other Usage Data
matrix.observedDataAndFlow: Server acceptance/reception status, revision/timestamps and invitation receipts support delivery/access workflow.
matrix.tracking: No analytics/tracking use shown for these service receipts.
matrix.remainingFact: Select exact ASC category based on actual retained action/status fields; receipt is not attendance RSVP. recipient-permissions references dataFlows rather than an evidence-file ID.

matrix.dataType: Location / Precise Location or Coarse Location
matrix.proposalStatus: Do not select solely because a coordinate exists; specific retained-flow assessment needed
matrix.observedDataAndFlow: Shared events can retain structured location coordinates; WeatherKit/map requests separately carry GPS, chosen-place or grid coordinates.
matrix.linkedToUser: Shared event coordinates are linked to event owner; do not assume every event place is user/device location.
matrix.tracking: No tracking use established in inspected location paths.
matrix.remainingFact: Determine whether retained fields describe user/device location, precision, and actual use. Distinguish planned venue from device position; Apple-only framework handling is not automatically developer collection.

matrix.dataType: User Content / Photos or Videos; Audio Data
matrix.proposalStatus: Conditional, inspect supported uploaded media types
matrix.observedDataAndFlow: Shared attachment model supports filenames/type/base64 content. Generic file support alone does not prove a dedicated photo/video/audio capture/upload flow.
matrix.purpose: App Functionality if supported and collected
matrix.linkedToUser: Likely yes for media attached to owned shared event.
matrix.tracking: No tracking use established in sharing path.
matrix.remainingFact: Owner/source review identifies actual enabled media upload types. Generic free text is Other User Content, not every sensitive category someone could type.

matrix.proposalStatus: Not established as whole-address-book server collection; targeted review needed
matrix.observedDataAndFlow: Google People API names/email/phone can be imported into iOS Contacts. Shared participant addresses are separately retained by sharing backend.
matrix.linkedToUser: Device imports are local; sharing participant list linkage is established.
matrix.tracking: No tracking use established by Contacts import.
matrix.remainingFact: Confirm any off-device address-book/social-graph transfer or contacts upload beyond individual participant fields. Do not claim the app never reads contacts; do not equate local write with developer collection.

matrix.dataType: Advertising SDK: Coarse Location, Device ID, Advertising Data, Product Interaction, Crash Data, Performance Data
matrix.proposalStatus: SDK-dependent disclosure gate; cannot finalize as none
matrix.observedDataAndFlow: Google Mobile Ads official disclosure lists possible IP-derived location, identifiers, ad/interaction and diagnostic data. Native ad requests/UMP paths exist unchanged at pinned commit.
matrix.purpose: Third-Party Advertising; Analytics and/or App Functionality as actual SDK use requires
matrix.linkedToUser: Unresolved per SDK/version/configuration; cannot blanket mark unlinked.
matrix.tracking: Unresolved. Ads alone do not prove tracking; determine cross-company data linkage/ad measurement/broker use and actual consent/config.
matrix.remainingFact: Check archived build16 SDK privacy manifests/report, dependency versions, mediation adapters and production AdMob/UMP/ATT configuration. Nonpersonalized ads or lack of IDFA do not by themselves establish no collection or no tracking.

matrix.dataType: WeatherKit / MapKit-only location requests and local map cache
matrix.proposalStatus: Do not automatically add as developer-collected location
matrix.observedDataAndFlow: Apple framework requests plus on-device grid forecast cache. No new own-server weather archive shown.
matrix.purpose: Weather/map functionality; label purpose only if developer/partner collection established
matrix.linkedToUser: Not established for developer collection; local grid may represent viewed region, not user location.
matrix.tracking: No source evidence of advertising linkage for weather paths.
matrix.remainingFact: Apple guidance excludes Apple’s own collection from developer responsibility; real-time-only requests and local storage do not alone meet collection definition. Verify any own logging/export or non-Apple retention separately; do not call all network requests ephemeral without proof.

fastestOwnerFactsNeeded.question: Does build16 use the inspected account/sharing/email backend with persistent records in production?
fastestOwnerFactsNeeded.impact: If yes, replace Data Not Collected and include the supported linked functionality categories. If owner asserts disabled, provide specific production feature/routing evidence; source alone does not establish disabled.

fastestOwnerFactsNeeded.question: What SDK privacy report/manifests and mediation/AdMob consent/tracking settings are present in the exact uploaded build16?
fastestOwnerFactsNeeded.impact: Resolve ad SDK categories, purposes, linkage and tracking; do not guess from ad presence or consent alone.

fastestOwnerFactsNeeded.question: Are push registration, media attachments and retained user/device location active, and what exact fields are stored?
fastestOwnerFactsNeeded.impact: Complete conditional matrix rows without overdeclaring arbitrary event text as every data category.

fastestOwnerFactsNeeded.question: Who handles account deletion, shared-record tombstones, backups and log retention, and what is the current production policy?
fastestOwnerFactsNeeded.impact: Correct policy/service transparency and assess separate account-deletion readiness; signout/cancellation is not erasure. Do not claim automatic full deletion.
